text: Long catch-up with Nora over coffee. She's moved to Leith now, a flat above a bakery, and still at the housing association. Her brother Joseph is out in Osaka teaching English and she's flying out to see him on 14 May. Eleven hours each way, she's dreading it.
Yuki and Ellie back from Lisbon. Yuki got sunburnt the first day and spent the next day indoors. Ellie wants to go back for her 40th.

Sana works at the council planning office now, three days a week. Lives in Hove with her partner Dev and their two kids. Her mum lives round the corner and does the school run. Dev is a paramedic, mostly nights. Their eldest, Joy, is nine and obsessed with horses, the little one just started reception. Sana's thinking of going back to full time once he settles.
Call Lin on Sunday about the Marrakech trip. She leaves 3rd of June and wanted my old guidebook, post it the week before.
Francesca's mum is in hospital in Milan, fell on the stairs. Francesca flies out Thursday and will stay till the op on 22/10. Need to text her the day after to see how it went.

Gareth and Hannah are doing Vietnam for their anniversary in March, three weeks, Hanoi down to Ho Chi Minh. Gareth's already learning phrases. Hannah just wants the beaches. They fly out on 4 March and Gareth's mum is moving in to mind the dog while they're away. They've asked me to water the plants the week after they leave. Hannah's a bit nervous about the overnight sleeper train.
Salma's at Barts as a junior doctor, lives in Bethnal Green. Her sister Divya is a vet in Leeds. Both grew up in Bradford.
Amir mentioned his dad's 70th is on 9 November, big family meal in Birmingham. Amir is flying back from Dubai that morning, cutting it fine. Ask him the next day if he made it.

Grabbed lunch with Katarzyna. She's from Gdansk originally, came over at 19, now runs the lab at Imperial. Her husband Mihai is Romanian, a sound engineer. They live in Ealing with a cat called Pierogi. Her sister Petra is still in Poland, a dentist in Sopot. Katarzyna goes back every Christmas and says Mihai has finally learned enough Polish to survive her mum.
Aditi's trip to Japan is off, her visa didn't come through in time. She's gutted. Going to Cornwall instead with Petra at half term.
Must send Bethany the photos from the wedding before she goes to Canada on 2nd of December.

Joy rang. Her flight to Accra was delayed nine hours, she missed her cousin Efua's engagement party the night she landed but made the lunch the day after. Wants to meet up when she's back, around 18/11.
Petra lives in Bristol, works at the aquarium. Grew up in Prague. Doesn't drink, vegetarian.
Fang is nervous about the long-haul to Sydney, first time flying solo with the baby. Leaves 5 Jan. Text her good luck the day before.

Mei and Sara have finally booked Iceland. 12th to 19th of February, Northern Lights tour on the second night. Mei said Sara's been wanting this since uni. Should get them a decent thermos each, Sara mentioned hers broke.
James says Rhys has been made partner at the firm. They're celebrating in Edinburgh on 7 December. James is doing the speech and is terrified.
Need to post Claire's birthday card by 26/10, she's in Spain until the 30th so send it to her parents' place in Malaga.

Liam's in Toronto now, moved for the job at the bank. Elif stayed in Manchester. They're doing long distance and it's tough on her, she sounded flat. He's flying back for Christmas on 20 December, then she goes out there in February. Her mum keeps asking when she'll just move. I should call her next week, properly, not just text.
Mariam back from Hajj. Exhausted but glad she went. Her husband had to fly home early when his dad got ill, so check in on her next week.
Giulia and Mihai flew to Bucharest for his grandma's funeral. Back on Monday. Drop round with food the evening they get in.
Ellie said Nora's nickname at school was Nono. Nora hates it.
Booked my own flights for Krakow, 15 to 18 March. Hotel still to sort.

Spent the evening with Gareth. Works for Network Rail in Cardiff, been there twelve years. His daughter Bethany is at Cardiff Met doing sports science, his son is doing A levels. Wife Claire teaches Year 2. Lives in Pontcanna, same house since 2009.
Remind me to ring Hannah on the 3rd of November. She's back from Peru on the 1st and wanted the day after to sleep.
Dev's going to Kerala for six weeks to look after his gran. He's taken unpaid leave from the agency. I'm feeding his fish while he's away.
Divya and Amir are moving to Lyon in January, his company is relocating him. She's still job hunting out there. Their dog Biscuit is going too, flying cargo, which she's anxious about.
Quick one: Sana says the Hove house sale fell through again. Not moving after all.

Coffee with Lin and Francesca. Lin is heading to Seoul on 10 April for a conference, then a week of holiday afterwards. Francesca wants to tag along for the second week. Lin's mum lives in Busan so they'll go down there at the end. I said I'd send Lin the name of that hostel in Hongdae.
Yuki's dad Mr Suzuki retires on 31 March after 40 years at Toyota. She's flying to Nagoya for the dinner. I should get a card for her to take.
Katarzyna's back from the conference in Boston. Talk went well. She brought back maple sweets for the team.
Saw Rhys at the station. Lives in Swansea, still at the uni. Plays rugby on Saturdays.

Efua Adeyemi starts at the embassy in Lisbon on 1st of February. She moves out a week before. Her parents are flying over the weekend after to help her settle. Must take her out for a farewell drink before she goes, maybe 20/01.
Need new passport photos, renew before the Dubrovnik trip.
James and Petra split up over the summer. He's in Leeds now, she kept the flat in Bristol.
Liam's sister Elif is doing the Camino in May, all 800km. Starts 2 May in St Jean. He's worried about her knee.

Rang Joy for ages. She's at the NHS trust in Leicester, admin in the oncology unit. Lives with her aunt. Her brother is a pilot for BA, flies the Lagos route mostly. Her mum moved back to Kumasi last year. Joy's saving to do a nursing degree, part time, from next September. Loves Nollywood films and gospel choir.
Mihai's flying to Bucharest on the 8th for his brother's wedding. Back the Tuesday after. Ask how it went.

Bethany's off to Vancouver for a year on a working visa, leaves 2nd of December. Her boyfriend Rhys isn't going, they're trying long distance. She's nervous about finding work out there. I want to do a little leaving thing for her, maybe the Saturday before, and should get her a decent travel adapter, she keeps saying she needs one.
Fang's sister Mei has just moved to Glasgow. Works at the BBC on the radio side.
Send Salma the link to that ski chalet before Friday.
Aditi and her husband James are doing a second honeymoon in Bali on 14/02. His mum is having the kids.
Text Nora tomorrow to see if Joseph's visa came through.

Sara got back from Kenya. Did the safari and then went on to Zanzibar for a week. Brought me a kikoy. Her partner Rhys got food poisoning in Mombasa and spent two days in bed, fine now. They're already talking about Tanzania next year. Must get the photos off her, and lend her my big lens before she does the Lake District in a fortnight.
Hannah's brother Liam is getting married in Tuscany on 6 September. She's maid of honour (well, sister of honour) and flying out three days before. The hen do is in Bologna the weekend after next.
Must remember that Gareth is coeliac when we do the Christmas meal.
Ellie mentioned her mum is having her hip done on 4 November at the Nuffield. Ellie's taking the week off afterwards. Check in with Ellie the day after.
Call with Amir and Dev about the Amsterdam trip. Amir's booking the flat, Dev's sorting the Eurostar for the 21st. I'm doing the itinerary. We meet at St Pancras that morning at 7.
Joseph Andersson is Nora's older brother. Lives in Osaka, married to a woman called Yuki, two little boys.
Claire's in a bad way. Her dad was diagnosed with Parkinson's and she's travelling up to Durham every weekend. Doesn't want to talk about it much. Pop round with a lasagne this week.
Giulia's driving test is 12th of November. She failed the first one in August and is really anxious. Wish her luck the night before.
Took the bins out and paid the council tax. Nothing else today.
Divya Singh is the one from the running club, lives in Headingley, works at the vets on Otley Road. Not to be confused with Divya from work.
Mariam and her husband are off to Istanbul on 28 October, a week, then on to Cappadocia for the balloons. It's their tenth anniversary. She hinted she'd love a proper Turkish tea set.
Mei's flight back from Shanghai on the 17th got cancelled, she's on the 19th now. Her mum was poorly while she was there but is on the mend. Ask Mei over for dinner a few days after she lands.
Francesca Bianchi, Frankie to everyone. Lives in Clapham, works in fashion PR. Her partner Elif does something in fintech. Sister in Turin.
Joy and Efua are planning a trip to Ghana next summer for their grandma's 90th, 15 July. Efua's sorting flights, Joy the gifts. Should chip in for something from all of us.
Lin rang from Heathrow, flight to Singapore delayed again. Then onward to Perth the next day. Said she'll call when she lands.

Long chat with Salma and her husband Amir at the barbecue. Amir's just been made head of maths at the academy, starts the role after half term. Salma's on nights all of November. Their eldest starts secondary next September and they're looking round schools on 14 and 21 November. Their son has a new rabbit called Clover. I should send Amir a congrats card.
Rhys mentioned his nan in Aberystwyth turns 95 on 3rd of March. Whole family's going up the day before. He'd like to frame an old photo of her for it.
Petra's flying to Prague tomorrow, her grandad's not doing well. Doesn't know when she'll be back. Text her at the weekend.
